_comment: SRC-12 decision 4 shared test vector. Written once with the Python cryptography package's AESGCM (key = the 32 bytes described by key_length, key_start, key_step, built by each test, never stored as text, nonce = bytes 100..111, associated data = the file name). Read by lakehouse-api (src/secret_crypto.rs) and by dagster (dispar_orchestrate/test_secret_resolver.py) so the two implementations cannot drift. Not a real key; nothing here protects anything.
format: version byte 0x01, 12-byte nonce, AES-256-GCM ciphertext with its 16-byte tag; associated data = UTF-8 file name
